mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the FEDFUNDS rate above 4% in the month prior to the decision is associated with a near-term negative S&P 500 20-day forward return due to tightened financing conditions.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4% in the prior month
regime_hint: high inflation or policy tightening cycle
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from the mean of the prior 30 months (p > 0.1) during the identified trigger.

mechanism_narrative: Rising monthly PAYEMS (labor market strength) coincides with a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 trading days as strong hiring signals corporate optimism.
failure_condition: Over 60-day horizon, the 20-day ahead returns are not significantly above the 30-day rolling mean (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly decline in HOUST (industrial production) of at least 2% predicts a negative S&P 500 5-day forward return as weak demand curbs corporate earnings expectations.
candidate_trigger: HOUST decreases by ≥2% in two consecutive months
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not negative in 70% of such events (binomial test).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in INDPRO (industrial production index) below 104.5 triggers a positive S&P 500 20-day forward return as expectations for future supply constraints improve risk sentiment.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05) during the trigger period.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE (labor cost pressure) produce a positive S&P 500 20-day forward return as dual headwinds reduce inflationary pressure.
failure_condition: Interaction IC < 0.05 and 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden spike in RSAFS (retail sales) above 700k suggests temporary demand recovery, predicting a positive S&P 500 5-day forward return.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not positive in 60% of triggered events (binomial).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of CPIAUCSL inflation above 3% are associated with negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns as expectations for persistent price pressures dampen equity valuations.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.1) during the trigger.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in GDPC1 (goods orders) above 20,000 million USD in the prior quarter is a leading indicator for a positive S&P 20-day forward return as it signals production momentum.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.1) during the 6-month post-spike period.
